intended_object: An auxiliary fresh variable used inside a machine-generated nominal proof certificate (`nb095_alpha_dummy_141`). It is a variable chosen fresh with respect to the free variables of an earlier dummy class term. I inferred this from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body just returns `freshVar (fv (Class.cv (nb095AlphaDummy134 D R S_cls E))) 0`. That is a fresh variable picked for alpha-renaming inside a proof certificate that was generated upstream. The docstring itself calls it a "checked nominal proof certificate", and the name ends in "AlphaDummy141". It is an implementation detail of the library's proof-replay machinery. It has no counterpart in the mathematical literature, so there is nothing to compare it against.
